issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict accepts negative integers as valid 'id' values without validation

source_files.description: Added validation in Todo.from_dict to ensure 'id' is a positive integer (id > 0)

test_files.description: Added 3 regression tests for negative/zero/positive id validation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Todo.from_dict({'id': -1, 'text': 'x'}) raises ValueError with message about positive id

implementation_summary: Added validation in Todo.from_dict() at line 76-80 to check that todo_id > 0 after integer conversion. Raises ValueError with clear message when id is negative or zero.
risks_limitations: Minimal risk - validation is additive and does not change behavior for valid positive IDs. Could affect code that was incorrectly using negative IDs.
